headline: Corpus: 2,526 distinct driver-GPS service runs (2,426 clean after map-matching) from 157 hashed driver accounts over 855 driver-days (2026-02-06 to 2026-06-29). The figure 43,809 is the sum of per-route run counts over 186 plan routes (run-route incidences, 17.3 per run), not a count of runs. The run-time checks use 14 corridor matches on 11 plan routes (815 runs, 53 distinct drivers [private one-off count]), all in Srinagar and its immediate belt, one operator's app; the headline plan-vs-observed time statistics use only the 5 `matched` corridors (470 runs, 48 distinct drivers; routes FDR-050, FDR-262, FDR-270, FDR-370, FDR-575). Those 5 are the corridors the plan was re-timed on in v3.4.5, so any comparison of the published plan with them is in-sample. Plan/observed one-way time on them: median ratio 0.51, MAPE 47.6 % against the pre-correction plan (verdict fail); median ratio 0.71, MAPE 25.6 % against the published plan (verdict fail; in-sample; n = 5, criterion MAPE < 20 % and rho > 0.5). Out-of-sample (8 partial-match corridors on 6 routes, 263 runs; 21 distinct drivers [private one-off count]): plan/observed pace median ratio 0.66, MAPE 31.1 %, rho +0.12 (verdict fail); over all 14 corridors: median ratio 0.84, MAPE 21.3 % (verdict fail). Moving speed (OSRM / 2.2 against observed, n = 14 corridors, 815 runs): MAPE 28.4 %, rho -0.07, verdict fail; the mean signed bias of +1.4 % is descriptive only (errors of opposite sign cancel) and is not a pass statistic. Route length, matched corridors only (n = 5): MAPE 18.3 %, rho +1.00, verdict pass (n < 8: no usable interval); on all 14 matches incl. partials the same test is not valid. Dwell (engine 1.0 min/km against observed, n = 18 corridors, 964 runs): MAPE 61.6 %, rho -0.37, verdict fail. Alignment coverage of the 186 plan routes: observed at all on 183 (weakest criterion), >= 50 % of length on 171, >= 80 % on 137, fully on 33; median 94 % of length. Fleet on the 5 re-timed routes at observed pace: 28 buses against 27 in the published plan (+3.7 %, in-sample) and 20 before re-timing (+40.0 %); not extrapolable to the 186 routes. Criteria declared in: module, same commit as first results.

membership.note: the observed-pace marginals are over all profiled corridors; five of them are the corridors the plan was re-timed on. The support is Srinagar-weighted and one operator's app.

monte_carlo_priors.plan_over_observed_oneway_note: pre-v3.4.5 plan one-way / observed one-way, 14 corridor matches (5 of them in-sample for the re-timing)
monte_carlo_priors.recommended_use: Sample one_way_pace_min_per_km directly in place of the OSRM-times-congestion-plus-dwell chain for the urban routes, and report fleet as an interval. The observed support is Srinagar-weighted, so this prior is applied to Urban and Peri_Urban classes only; rural pace is unobserved and must stay as modelled with the uncertainty stated.

moving_speed_note: mean_signed_bias_pct is descriptive; the verdict uses MAPE and rho. Corridors are not assigned to congestion zones, so each divisor is applied to every corridor.

plan_versions.note: on the out-of-sample corridors the two plan versions coincide to rounding (reality_check rounds to 0.1 min); they differ only on routes v3.4.5 re-timed.

route_coverage.note: obs_frac is the share of the planned alignment seen in driver GPS. Routes at zero reflect app adoption among drivers, not proven dormancy; the corroborated counts are floors.
route_coverage.obs_frac_median_note: median over all 186 routes, including those at zero
route_coverage.total_distinct_drivers_max_note: maximum over routes of the per-route driver count; not a total. Distinct drivers in the corpus: corpus.drivers_distinct.
route_coverage.total_observed_runs_note: ROUTE-INCIDENCES, not runs: a run is counted once for every plan route it overlaps. Use corpus.distinct_runs_total / distinct_runs_clean for run counts.
